description: Preserve and repair the .agro/memories/ tier: tracked templates and a scoped contract, Git- and Docker-excluded live instances, non-overwriting initialization through the existing entrypoint path, scoped loading with no automatic loader, worktree isolation, truthful distribution and probes, role-neutral defaults

userStories.title: Restore the tier as tracked templates plus a scoped contract
userStories.description: As an operator, I want .agro/memories/ to ship canonical templates and a scoped directory contract so that the repository distributes defaults without tracking anyone's live instance.
acceptanceCriteria: Restore .agro/memories/AGENTS.md as a tracked scoped contract that names the three live files, the templates that seed them, and the initialization behavior
The contract removes the universal 'Read all three at session start' mandate and states scoped, on-demand reading; it invents no automatic loader, hook, or root AGENTS.md mandate
Add tracked .agro/memories/templates/{SOUL,USER,MEMORY}.md derived from the ab86a8c3 originals
Templates are role-neutral: no default directs its reader to own decisions, assignment, or acceptance, and none assigns the advisor role to a bounded worker
Templates carry no operator identity: no name, GitHub handle, git identity, or email address
MEMORY.md template starts empty of dated entries and documents the dated-entry format
git ls-files .agro/memories lists exactly AGENTS.md and the three templates; no live SOUL.md/USER.md/MEMORY.md is tracked
userStories.notes: C1 C3 C4 — ownership, scoped loading, role neutrality
userStories.evidence: Advisor-verified: git ls-files .agro/memories = AGENTS.md + 3 templates; no live instance tracked; contract states scoped on-demand reading and "installs no loader"; templates role-neutral and identity-free.

userStories.title: Exclude live instances from Git and the Docker build context

acceptanceCriteria: Add .gitignore rules ignoring .agro/memories/SOUL.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md while keeping AGENTS.md and templates/ tracked; place them beside the existing .agro/tasks and .agro/logs task-artifact rules
Add the matching .dockerignore rules so the live files are not build inputs
A live file created in the checkout does not appear in git status --porcelain -uall
Existing operator content at those paths is preserved byte-for-byte by every step of this story; nothing is overwritten, recursively cleaned, published, or silently discarded
userStories.evidence: Advisor-verified with synthetic private fixtures: git check-ignore names .gitignore:35-37; real docker build over this checkout listed only AGENTS.md + templates in the context while synthetic SOUL.md/USER.md sat on disk (tracked files are the positive control).

userStories.title: Seed missing live files non-destructively at the existing entrypoint path

acceptanceCriteria: Seed from .agro/memories/templates/ into .agro/memories/ inside the existing workspace-directory initialization block in .devcontainer/entrypoint.sh (the WORKTREES_PATH/PROJECTS_PATH/CRONS_PATH block near line 526)
A missing live file is created; an existing live file is left byte-for-byte unchanged, including an empty one

shellcheck -S warning passes on .devcontainer/entrypoint.sh, which CI already lints
userStories.notes: C2 C4 — existing attachment point, no new machinery, isolation
userStories.evidence: Advisor integration test against the real templates: first run seeds all three; repeat run preserves an operator-modified USER.md byte-for-byte and leaves an empty MEMORY.md empty. install -d removal proven to change no case.

userStories.title: Ship templates, contract, and probe together in the manifest
userStories.description: As an installed project, I want the memory templates and their contract to arrive with the probe that asserts on them so that no probe asserts on a subject the payload omits.
acceptanceCriteria: Add the memories templates and contract to .agro/manifest.json include so an installed project receives them
The live instance paths are never part of the payload
oh update --from <built-checkout> into a fresh target creates the templates and the contract, and the counts are recorded
A repeat run of the same install overwrites no operator-modified file
userStories.evidence: REAL `oh update --from` into a fresh non-git target AND a fresh git-init target: 541 created / 0 overwritten / 399 skipped each; payload carries the contract and templates and never a live instance; --force repeat install preserved synthetic private content.

userStories.title: Repair both probes to assert the preserved contract truthfully
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want both probes to test what the repository actually ships in each deployment so that the suite is honest rather than merely green.
acceptanceCriteria: Rewrite .agro/evals/probes/memories-tier-defaults.sh to assert on the TEMPLATES and the contract, never on a live instance; the guide's 'edit in place' instruction must no longer be able to turn the suite red

Every injection is reverted with git checkout HEAD -- <path> so the index is reset, and git status --porcelain is proven empty afterwards
Full-suite baseline recorded before and after; any failure predating this change is named, and no check is weakened to green
userStories.notes: C5 — probes and fault injection. The staged-typechange failure from the retirement build must not recur.
userStories.evidence: Both probes exit 0 in all three deployments with distinct, truthful mode messages. Real-install testing found and closed a coverage gap (live-instance guard now runs wherever an index exists); pre-fix probe exit 0 vs current exit 1 on the same injection.
